title: Implement LIST OVERVIEW.FMT (RFC 6048)
description: LIST OVERVIEW.FMT tells clients the exact field order in OVER/XOVER output. Without this, some clients assume a default order that may not match the server's output, causing malformed overview display. The response is a static list of field names matching the overview index schema. Artifact: LIST OVERVIEW.FMT handler in usenet-ipfs-reader.
